title: Customer sources are no longer auto-expanded by default
summary: The sources property on Customers is no longer included by default.

migrationNotes.text: Lets you optimize performance by not automatically including the sources property on the Customer object. You can still expand the list of sources, but Stripe recommends it for performance reasons.

sources.quote: | [Customer sources are no longer auto-expanded by default](https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/2020-08-27/deprecates-auto-expansion-customer-sources.md) | Payments, Billing, Invoicing | Breaking | api |
The `sources` property on `Customers` is no longer included by default.
